description: Java class implementing an MQTT CONNECT packet authentication handler for extracting username and password credentials, with tracing support.

classes.name: ConnectPacketAuthHandler
classes.description: Handles authentication by extracting username and password from MQTT CONNECT packets, with tracing context injection.

methods.name: ConnectPacketAuthHandler
methods.description: Constructor initializing the auth handler with an auth provider and tracer.

methods.name: parseCredentials
methods.description: Extracts credentials from MQTT CONNECT packet, returns a Future with JSON credentials or fails with an exception.
